sermon.title: A Prediction Involving Two Persons 06/24/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows how Psalm 109, Psalm 41:9, Zechariah 11 and Jeremiah 32 foretold Judas and Jesus, as Acts 1 confirms. Judas was a trusted friend and apostle but a greedy thief; Satan used him and position-minded leaders, with God’s permission. He applies this to leaders who use the poor and faith for votes, talks about poverty and taxes, and warns that Satan divides believers.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Garbled words are marked [unclear], including two verse references. Kept as spoken: “Jesus preached the gospel” where Judas is meant (16:01); “twice in the Bible” for poor in spirit and the kingdom; responsible for your decisions “once you become twenty” (14:06). Unverified: John McCain joined a Baptist church two months before running (21:05); claims about Obama’s and Bush Jr.’s books (21:58); California gas tax 25–30%, housing tax 10% of $25,000 income, poor people pay over 50% in taxes (28:57–30:56). Sensitive content kept as spoken: Catholics confess to priests (9:42); “dumbed down Christians” (20:10); Jesus never gave to the poor and the early church never gave to heathen poor (22:39); “any idiot knows” about a $15 minimum wage (27:41); called himself “poor white trash”; Black Lives Matter among “meaningless nonsense” (40:01); only Christians can be mistreated in America (43:20); Swaggart and Bakker exposed (44:25); Bill Clinton “having sex with every woman around” (45:18).
